payload.description:
# Coach and enforce story-stage prerequisites

## Intent

As a newsroom operator, I want each transition to explain and enforce its editorial prerequisite, so that agents learn the process and cannot silently skip required work.

## Behavior specification

Feature: Gate newsroom story transitions

Scenario: Coach before a transition is attempted
  Given a story is in a stage with a defined next editorial artifact
  And the artifact is not ready
  When an agent inspects or works with the story through Kanbus
  Then Kanbus emits guidance naming the missing work
  And the guidance explains why the work belongs before the next stage

Scenario: Refuse an incomplete transition
  Given a story is ready to attempt a configured stage transition
  And the artifact required by that transition is missing, empty, or invalid
  When the agent requests the transition through Kanbus
  Then the transition fails closed
  And the story remains in its current stage
  And the response identifies a concrete recovery action

Scenario: Allow a complete transition
  Given the required artifact satisfies the configured gate
  When the agent requests the transition through Kanbus
  Then the transition succeeds
  And the Kanbus event history records the stage change

## Boundary

Slice 1 implements file checks with lifecycle hooks. It must not add newsroom predicates to Kanbus core.
